page.overview:
Who is Ao Run?

Ao Run and the other Dragon Kings were summoned by Ao Guang when Sun Wukong demanded to be given a new set of clothes — part of Journey to the West.

Ao Run convinced his brother, Ao Qin, that Sun Wukong was too dangerous to fight, and that they sound comply with his demands, then alert Heaven to arrest him. Ao Run gave Sun Wukong his Gold Chain Armor.

In Journey to the West, Ao Run sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
